name: NLST, full (tier 2; 500-person pilot fetched)
what: the National Lung Screening Trial in IDC v24 (TCIA doi:10.7937/tcia.hmq8-j677), full: 24,713 subjects, about 2,305 GB raw plus screen; the 500-person pilot is fetched (the manifest's nlst_pilot, in the harvest)
level_truth: counted by the census pipeline once fetched
status: planned in the data platform at bf1432f and refused as it stands by the stopping rule (2.3 TB for about 110 T13 people, its only yield, about 1.5 percent single-labeller calls that all need adjudication); no fetch job until the owner lifts that rule; the ranking's refusals: localizer 65,174, slice over 3.0 mm 21,188, under 60 slices 5,209, not a regularly spaced 3-D volume 3,652
how_to_get: Regenerate manifests/idc_tier2.csv with spinesurg-ct-nnunet's tools/acquisition_census.py --calibration fov_calibration.json --aa3-meta aa3_meta.csv --nbia-fdg fdg_ct_series.json --out ... (the last two inputs are not on local disk), then bash ~/spinesurg-ct-nnunet/slurm/acquisition_submit.sh tier2.

The route as the manifest prints it: python3 data/reproduce/reacquire/reacquire.py --grid idc_nlst; on the grid, from ~/spinesurg-ct-nnunet/data_platform/reacquire, sbatch -D "$PWD" --export=ALL,IDS="idc_nlst",MODE=--run reacquire.sbatch, as a Slurm job on the owner's word.
